items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: He was the trumpet man. He's the one who had the band in charge for his brass band I had. I mean, I worked with... I worked with him for years.

ctx.x: Oh, did he? I forgot to ask you something. What was the first brass band you played with? I don't know. I know it was. I sure remember.

I don't want to start playing with the boys. Let me see where the... In the Jefferson Boys? Yeah Jefferson City Boys, I mean the bass band. Yeah, he's playing for the... I can't follow that man's name. Rene, how much? Wait a minute, I called his name this morning. Corpintuck. Wait a minute. He did, uh... Dejama Gunye. Yeah, Dejama Gunye. He had, uh... That was my cousin. Yeah, your cousin. Yeah. He was the first man over here. We had, uh... He was called the Gunye's band, or I could remember the brass band at…
And who was in that band?
